note: At level 10 you now choose a class that actually changes how you fight. Four teachers have moved into Mosslight: Dain teaches warriors at the Wayfarer Guild, Sable teaches mages, Puck teaches rogues, and Wynn teaches archers. They teach at the guild by day and wander to the Rusty Tankard in the evening, so talk to one when you reach level 10 — changing class later is free. Warriors hit 2 damage harder, rogues crit more often and strike from stealth three times as hard, archers shoot 25 percent harder, and mages open a Spells tab in the Skills panel with real magic: Ember Bolt throws fire at the nearest foe within range, Veil Step blinks you two paces in the direction you face, and Frost Ward hardens your skin with 3 extra armor until your next wound. Spells cost mana drawn from your intelligence, refill slowly on their own, and every cast plays a fire, frost, or veil animation on the field. Effect frames come from a user-supplied effects pack that ships no license file, so no license terms are claimed for them.
